title: Armageddon dream with the number 747 and number cubes

tellings.quote: incredibly vivid dream in in the midst of all this at that Fort Knox where I dreamt that I was in a battle like a battle of Armageddon.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says that in 1976, while at Fort Knox, an Army base in Kentucky, he had an incredibly vivid dream of fighting in a battle like Armageddon, the final battle at the end of the world. He says the dream featured the number 747 and cubes with numbers on them, and he tells it as one of the experiences that led him to wonder whether he could glimpse the future.
